purpose: Strengthen path activation without manually inventing exudate mass by feeding model-produced INITIAL.OUT state back through the ordinary INITIAL.INP parser and comparing legacy against the atomic Bfom-only diagnostic observation.

diagnostic_build.candidate_only_source_change: Outbal_Init.for adds Bfom(Inip_x,Ly) = Bfom(Inip_x,Ly) + Ex(Ln) * P

runtime_adaptations: Windows path separators changed only in execution copy
case-insensitive file aliases materialized in execution copy
quoted PrintBalLabel payloads unquoted without changing labels
PowerStation sequential-unformatted record framing converted while preserving logical payload bytes

state_replay.input_method: Exact model-produced INITIAL.OUT bytes copied to execution-copy Input/initial.inp
state_replay.caveat: The hydrology/management chronology is replayed from the original case start. This is therefore parser/state-path activation using model-produced restart-format state, not a true accepted-boundary chronological continuation.

legacy.interpretation: Printed legacy deviation is the rounded form of the omitted 5989.6594 kg/ha model-produced initial Ex store.

candidate.interpretation: Beginning Bfom gains only the model-produced Ex store; physical end state is unchanged. Difference between 5989.66 printed increment and 5989.6594 exact replay input is report rounding, not a tolerance.

negative_control.interpretation: Ordinary zero-Ex start does not expose TCD-026; the model-produced state replay does.

what_this_adds: Demonstrates that ANIMO itself can produce a nonzero persisted Rsex/EX restart-format state which, when consumed as initial state, activates exactly the TCD-026 ledger omission. The atomic Bfom-only diagnostic removes that omission without changing restart output bytes or non-whitelisted scientific outputs.
what_this_does_not_add: No historical reference, no chronological split-run qualification, no independent second-line review, no corrected-legacy admission and no production migration.
